description: The pie chart presents the distribution of a dataset across task categories, showing 7 slices in total: Math (colored light red/pink) at 29.3%, Coding (blue) at 24.3%, Information Seeking (light green) at 22.2%, Reasoning (light orange/peach) at 10.4%, Planning (light purple/lavender) at 2.3%, Creative Writing (light pink) at 2.2%, and Others (combined) (pale green) at 9.3%. Percentage labels are printed next to each slice, and a legend titled “Categories” appears in the upper-left listing each category with associated counts in parentheses. No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments do not appear arranged strictly in descending order by size.
